text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Enlistment (Designation of Forces for National Service) Notification.

2. The Minister for Defence has designated that service in any of the following organisations shall be national service for the purposes of the Act:
(a)the Singapore Civil Defence Force; and
(b)the Airport Fire and Rescue Service.
[G.N. No. S 136/75]
